title: Singapore dollar to Japanese yen, since 1988 (daily from 2003)
description: Yen per Singapore dollar and Singapore dollars per 100 yen, each working day from 2003 and each week from 1988: MAS's noon rate where MAS publishes one, and earlier days from the source named on each row.
question: What is the Singapore dollar worth in yen, on any day since 1988?

fields.name: date
fields.meaning: The day the rate is for.

fields.name: jpy_per_sgd
fields.meaning: How many yen one Singapore dollar buys (the inverse of the next column, kept to six decimals).

fields.name: sgd_per_100_jpy
fields.meaning: Singapore dollars per 100 yen, the way MAS quotes it.

fields.name: source
fields.meaning: Which figure the row is: MAS = MAS, as of noon; MAS weekly = MAS, weekly (before 2003).
